story: I loved Arc — the sidebar, the spaces, the way tabs got out of the way. But I wanted a browser that was mine, built from scratch, and open for anyone to read.

So I'm rewriting it clean-room: native SwiftUI and AppKit on WKWebView, with the same spaces, three-tier sidebar, one-click import from my own Arc data, tab hibernation, and a built-in ad blocker. No code from Arc, no Arc assets, no Arc trademarks — the look and feel, rebuilt.
It's in development now, and when it's ready it will be MIT-licensed and live at alpbrowser.app.
tagline: Your new favorite browser — human-first, AI-second.
